backend/main.mo: Defines an empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Provides feature evidence metadata linking a header text-size update to the SiteHeader component and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of key frontend files including styles, config, pages, and major marketing components.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive OKLCH-based CSS variables for light/dark themes and global element styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting viewport, SEO meta description, page title, and loading the main React script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling simple page routing, header/footer layout, and scroll-to-consultation behavior.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Consul: Contact section with phone, email, WhatsApp info and a form that supports mailto submission and local state management.
frontend/src/components/marketing/IconCa: Reusable icon card with gradient icon wrapper, responsive sizing, and hover effects on larger screens.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Pricin: Pricing card showing plan details, features, optional 'Most Popular' badge, and a Get Started button.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Proces: Four-step process UI component displaying consultation, design, development, and launch steps with icons.
frontend/src/components/marketing/SiteFo: Footer with branding, navigation links, contact info, and Caffeine.ai attribution with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/marketing/SiteHe: Responsive site header with navigation, mobile menu toggle, and a Get Started action that scrolls to the consultation section.
frontend/src/components/marketing/WhatsA: Floating WhatsApp chat button linking to a preset number using a styled circular button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor instance based on Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity login state, loading identities, and exposing login/clear functions.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, gradients, safe-area utilities, and global styles for typography and layout.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, wrapping the app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Marketing-focused homepage with hero content, feature sections, and calls to action for pricing or consultation.
frontend/src/pages/PricingPage.tsx: Pricing page displaying tiered pricing cards, feature descriptions, and supporting information.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, layout, shadows, animations, and loading typography, container query, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing versions, known mobile text-size issue, and one existing feature request to reduce mobile header text size.
